reason: The issue is only about the PBKDF2 iteration argument. The agent's check (iter <= 0 || iter > INT_MAX32) rejects 4294968296 and 2147483648 with the same 3047 warning the test expects, and those lines pass. The test fails only on the new key-width assertions (KDF(...,4294967552) and KDF(...,-4294967040) for the 5th argument), where the human fix also validates the width as a 64-bit value. The issue text never mentions key width, so the tests check extra scope the developers chose, not the behaviour the issue asked for.

The issue expects the old snapshot's SELECT after IMPORT TABLESPACE to fail with an error. The agent only set table->bulk_trx_id = trx->id, which does not invalidate the existing read view: the test's SELECT * FROM t1 succeeded where ER_TABLE_DEF_CHANGED was expected. The human fix sets index->trx_id for every index, which is what makes the snapshot check raise the error. The agent's change therefore does not produce the behaviour the issue asks for.

The agent fixed the undersized WKB header reserve in Gis_polygon, Gis_multi_line_string and Gis_multi_polygon::simplify, so the three CONCAT_WS queries pass. It missed the same bug in Gis_geometry_collection::simplify, and the COLUMN_GET(... ST_SIMPLIFY(GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(...))) query still crashes with the q_append assertion at spatial.cc:4724. The human fix also patched that function. This sibling case is part of the same overflow bug, so the fix is incomplete and the server still crashes.
